newsitem.title: USA: Electronic Designs has diamond drills.
newsitem.headline: Electronic Designs has diamond drills.

text.p: Electronic Designs Inc said its diamond products division, Crystallume, has expanded its line of Diamond Coated Carbide cutting tools to include diamond coated rotating tools such as drills and end mills.
Initially, the company said, it will target the new products for markets such as the machining of nonmetallic materials such as graphite, green ceramic and fiber reinforced plastic composites.
